indication.text: Radioactive diagnostic agent indicated for use with PET imaging of the brain to estimate the density and distribution of aggregated tau neurofibrillary tangles (NFTs) in adult patients with cognitive impairment who are being evaluated for Alzheimer's disease (AD); not indicated for evaluation of chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE).

citations.quote: TAUVID is indicated for use with positron emission tomography (PET) imaging of the brain to estimate the density and distribution of aggregated tau neurofibrillary tangles (NFTs) in adult patients with cognitive impairment who are being evaluated for Alzheimer's disease (AD).
TAUVID is not indicated for use in the evaluation of patients for chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) [see *Warnings and Precautions* (5.2)].

target_moa.text: Flortaucipir F 18 is a fluorine-18-labeled small molecule PET tracer that binds with high affinity to native paired helical filament (PHF)-tau (Kd 0.57 nM to 0.68 nM), allowing PET imaging of aggregated tau neurofibrillary tangles.

citations.quote: The drug substance in Tauvid is flortaucipir F 18 (FTP), a benzimidazole-pyrimidine derivative new small molecule labelled with fluorine 18 for imaging.
In vitro binding to native PHF-tau purified from human AD brain with subnanomolar affinity (K_d=0.57\text{nM} to 0.68\text{nM})

modality.text: Radiopharmaceutical (fluorine-18-labeled small molecule PET imaging agent).

citations.quote: The drug substance in Tauvid is flortaucipir F 18 (FTP), a benzimidazole-pyrimidine derivative new small molecule labelled with fluorine 18 for imaging.

The Applicant (Avid) submitted this new drug application (NDA) for Tauvid, a fluorine-18-labeled diagnostic positron emission tomography (PET) radiopharmaceutical, to image aggregated tau-neurofibrillary tangles (NFTs) (b) (4) of patients (b) (4) who are being evaluated for AD (b) (4).

key_safety.text: Among 1921 exposed participants, adverse reactions with frequency >=0.5% were headache 26 (1.4%), injection site pain 23 (1.2%), and increased blood pressure 15 (0.8%); no serious adverse events were deemed related to FTP.

citations.quote: In clinical studies, 1921 study participants were exposed to TAUVID [see *Clinical Studies* (14)].

Adverse Reaction	n (%)
Headache	26 (1.4%)
Injection site pain	23 (1.2%)
Increased blood pressure	15 (0.8%)

There were no serious adverse events deemed related to FTP administration. The incidence of mild to moderate adverse reactions was low with a frequency <3%. Among these adverse reactions, headache, injection site pain and increased blood pressure were the most common with a frequency of >0.5%.

detail.text: Approved on the first review cycle; the multidisciplinary team recommended approval and the NDA was approved effective on the date of the approval letter with no prior CRL noted.

citations.quote: We have completed our review of this application, as amended. It is approved, effective on the date of this letter, for use as recommended in the enclosed agreed-upon labeling.

Overall, multidisciplinary reviewers from each discipline represented on the team, including consulted subject matter experts, found that benefit-risk was favorable and recommend an approval action for Tauvid when used per agreed labeling for estimating the density and distribution of aggregated NFTs in adult patients with cognitive impairment who are being evaluated for AD.
